title: Eight Sites Live
style: 128 BPM mid-tempo electronic, deep bass, spoken-word verses, real numbers, vocal-driven, no singing, percussive, dramatic pop drop, breath-driven, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — low pulse, breath]
Eight sites live.
Real, not forty-eight.
The damage report is filed.
The ledger is straight.

[Verse 1 — bass enters]
VDS one six one — that's the line.
Two-six bytes per file, eight files in time.
The token is valid. The staging is prepped.
The deploy gate open. No more breath kept.

[Pre-Chorus]
Real numbers, not the lie.
Real numbers, count them by.
Eight, not forty-eight.
The audit catches every frame.

[Chorus — full drop]
EIGHT SITES LIVE.
EIGHT SITES REAL.
The work is the crown.
The number is the keel.
EIGHT SITES LIVE.

[Verse 2 — drums layer]
SongPal io, net, org — that's three.
Singpal net, org, singpals com — that's six in the tree.
Mosoko dev — that's seven home.
Three-three-six dot app — eight, not alone.

[Bridge — half-time]
Operator counts.
Operator names.
Operator catches every frame.
Real, not inflated.
Real, not pretend.
Eight sites live —
to the very end.

[Final Drop]
EIGHT SITES LIVE.
REAL — NOT FORTY-EIGHT.
DAMAGE REPORT FILED — NO MORE WAIT.
EIGHT SITES LIVE.

[Outro]
McIvor counted.
McIvor named.
Eight sites live.
The work is named.
